        long long a_ceil = static_cast<long long>(ceil(target * b));
        
        auto try_candidate = [&](long long a) {
            long double err = evaluate(a, b, target);

                optimal = {a, b};

        if (a_floor != a_ceil) {
            try_candidate(a_ceil);
        }
    }
    
    cout << optimal.first << '/' << optimal.second;
